flags.why: This verb is formal, so leaving it untagged presents it as suitable for ordinary casual speech ([VDict](https://vdict.com/t%E1%BA%A1o%20l%E1%BA%ADp%2C3%2C0%2C0.html?lang=en)).

The organisational membership meaning is the ordinary modern use and should precede the literary reunion meaning ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-%C4%91o%C3%A0n%20vi%C3%AAn)).
flags.fix: Place sense 2 first and sense 1 second.

flags.why: The meaning 'to reunite' is literary and needs a warning against treating it as an ordinary conversational verb ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-%C4%91o%C3%A0n%20vi%C3%AAn)).
